info.name: A7 Analytics Platform - Algo management Algo management API Sending times, packets, messages API
retrieves list of packets' sending times, or complete packets

params.name: date
params.description: trading day in the format YYYYMMDD

params.name: mode
params.description:
Define the output format for the response.
Mode options: * `reference` (default) - Shows a list of the referencing IDs * `detailed` - Shows a list of packets with messages including their details

params.name: limit
params.description: max number of elements in the response

params.name: from
params.description: array of packet's sending times as start times for (multiple) time interval selection (multiple values are separated by comma)

params.name: to
params.description: packet's sending time as a global end time for (multiple) time interval selection

params.name: msgSeqNum
params.description: array of packet's sequence numbers used as a filter to select packets (multiple values are separated by comma)

params.name: templateId
params.description: array of templateIDs used as a filter to select packets (multiple values are separated by comma)

items.docs: The request delivers a list of the available sending times, or alternatively complete packets for the selected exchange, trading day, asses and security.

params.name: date
params.description: trading day in the format YYYYMMDD

items.docs: The request delivers the details of the packet identified by the selected exchange, trading day, asset, security and packet's sending time.</br>  For a detailed description of the different message types please refer to the CME MDP documentation.
